tripIdea.fr: Pour un premier voyage depuis la France, beaucoup arrivent à Montréal, où l'on se sent vite chez soi grâce au français. Un circuit classique relie Montréal, Québec et la région de Charlevoix, avec une escapade à Tadoussac pour observer les baleines en été et au début de l'automne. Comptez dix à quatorze jours ; avec plus de temps, poursuivez vers Toronto et les chutes du Niagara.
tripIdea.en: For a first trip from France, many travellers land in Montreal, where speaking French makes it easy to settle in. A classic loop links Montreal, Quebec City and the Charlevoix region, with a side trip to Tadoussac for whale watching in summer and early autumn. Allow ten to fourteen days; with more time, continue to Toronto and Niagara Falls.

Les liens entre les deux pays restent forts : chaque printemps, Ottawa accueille son festival des tulipes, né d'un don de la famille royale néerlandaise après la Seconde Guerre mondiale.
tripIdea.en: Amsterdam has nonstop flights to several Canadian cities, so you can arrive in the East and leave from the West. Ties between the two countries remain strong: every spring Ottawa hosts its Tulip Festival, born of a gift from the Dutch royal family after the Second World War.

tripIdea.en: Newfoundland shares a long history with Ireland: accents, music and place names recall the Irish roots of part of its population. Its capital, St. John's, is the easternmost city in North America and an unusual stop before Toronto or Montreal.

tripIdea.en: From the UAE, the nonstop flight to Toronto is the simplest option. Many travellers use it to visit Niagara Falls, about an hour and a half away by road, and enjoy the Canadian summer, much cooler than the Gulf, ideal for Ontario's parks and lakes.

Pour un séjour plus long, les jeunes Australiens peuvent se renseigner sur le programme Expérience internationale Canada.
tripIdea.en: Whistler, about two hours from Vancouver, is one of the ski resorts most visited by Australians, who often come during their summer holidays, in the middle of the Canadian winter. For a longer stay, young Australians can look into the International Experience Canada program.
